title: Club news: Local UFO club meets July 25

title: Kecksburg UFO festival delivers other-worldly experience
description: The sky cleared over Mt. Pleasant Township Saturday afternoon — but not enough to let a UFO crash through the clouds.

title: Experts Explore Conventional Explanations for UFO Sightings
description: Recent investigations into UFO sightings have led experts to propose conventional explanations, such as laser-generated plasmas. However, one notable incident involving an orb releasing smaller orbs remains unexplained. Dr. Avi Loeb and Admiral Tim Gallaudet discuss the complexities of these sightings, highlighting the limitations of current theories like ball lightning. As the Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office continues to scrutinize these phenomena, the quest for understanding unexplained aerial encounters persists. Read on to explore the latest findings and theories surrounding these mysterious occurrences.

title: Trump UFO Files: Scientists Explain Mysterious Glowing Orbs, Except One Chilling Pentagon Encounter
description: Advisers from the Trump administration's UAP Science Advisory Council suggest that many recent UFO sightings of glowing orbs may be explained by laser-generated plasmas.

title: Bay Area UFO files: Disclosures could fuel more reports of aliens
description: SAN JOSE, Calif. — It was the late 1950s when Ruben Uriarte saw his first UFO — a silvery, oval-shaped object hovering by the Oakland foothills.
